one_line: Last known Maitraka ruler of Vallabhi in Saurashtra, c. 762–776 CE.

appearance.face: oval face, medium wheatish complexion, sharp nose, neatly groomed short beard and moustache, calm observant eyes with a slightly furrowed brow, default expression dignified and thoughtful
appearance.hair: straight, dark brown-black hair reaching just past the nape, parted slightly off-center and combed back; topped with a simple gold circlet-style crown set with a single small red gemstone at the center
appearance.costume: royal Maitraka court attire: a long-sleeved, knee-length tunic-kurta of fine off-white cotton with subtle woven borders, worn under a saffron-ochre silk uttariya (drape) wrapped over the left shoulder and around the torso, paired with fitted maroon churidar-style trousers; a broad gold waistband with simple incised patterns at the waist, gold kadas (bracelets) on both wrists, a short multi-strand gold necklace, and plain leather sandals; overall look restrained but unmistakably royal and era-appropriate to 8th-century Saurashtra.
appearance.signature: a copper-plate grant bundle: several rectangular copper plates pierced at one end and tied together with a dark cord, held reverently in his left hand, their engraved surfaces catching light

ref_desc: Siladitya VI Dhruvatta appears as a dignified wheatish-complexioned king with short dark hair, neat beard, gold circlet crown, off-white tunic, saffron-ochre drape, maroon trousers, gold ornaments, leather sandals, and a tied copper-plate grant bundle in hand with saffron, maroon, off-white, gold tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Siladitya VI Dhruvatta: a dignified early-30s king from 8th-century Vallabhi with an oval wheatish face, calm sharp eyes, and a neatly groomed short beard and moustache. His straight dark brown-black hair reaches just past the nape, parted slightly off-center and combed back, topped with a simple gold circlet crown bearing a single small red gemstone at the center. He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length off-white cotton tunic with subtle woven borders, over fitted maroon churidar-like trousers, and a broad gold waistband at his waist. A saffron-ochre silk uttariya drape wraps from his right side across his torso and over his left shoulder, falling in graceful folds. Gold kadas on both wrists, a short multi-strand gold necklace, and plain brown leather sandals complete his restrained royal look. In his left hand he holds his signature prop, a bundle of rectangular copper plates pierced at one end and tied with a dark cord, their engraved surfaces catching the light. Use a palette dominated by saffron-ochre, maroon, off-white, gold, and dark brown, and present him front-facing with clear views of face, hair, crown, draped garments, ornaments, sandals, and copper-plate grant for consistent redraws.
